ctor.rationale: `base(0, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.RandomEnemy)` with `protected override bool HasEnergyCostX => true` (Volley.cs:13-20) == `energy_cost_x = True` (cards/base.py:84-87) plus `_energy_cost = 0`. As with card/cascade, the base cost of 0 is exactly right for an X-cost card: `CardEnergyCost`'s constructor sets `Canonical = ((!CostsX) ? canonicalCost : 0)` (CardEnergyCost.cs:86), so C# also holds 0.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(10m, ValueProp.Move)` (Volley.cs:15) == `_damage = 10`, powered on both sides.

OnPlay.issue: Closed 2026-07-29 (round 7): Routed to the stream its C# names. AttackCommand.cs:601-602 rolls `Rng.CombatTargets.NextItem(validTargets)` per hit, so the per-hit pick is `combat_rng.targets`. The X plumbing, the hit count, the allow-duplicates policy and the per-hit re-derivation of the living set were all already faithful. Re-verified current on this stale-sweep pass: `ctx.combat.combat_rng.targets.choice(living)` (colorless_attacks.py:548) is still the routed call.  Pinned by test/test_card_residue_gaps.py.  NOT CLOSED: nothing at this site.  The text it replaced read: The X-value plumbing, the hit count and the duplicates policy are all faithful: `WithHitCount(ResolveEnergyXValue())` (Volley.cs:24) == `for _ in range(self.captured_x)`, where `captured_x` is set by the play pipeline as `hooks.modify_x_value(card, player.energy)` (combat.py:970, moved from :547-549 -- the manual-play-path call site, content re-verified current), the sim's ResolveEnergyXValue; and `TargetingRandomOpponents(CombatState)` defaults `allowDuplicates: true` (AttackCommand.cs:309, 325, 72) so repeats are allowed, which independent per-hit choices reproduce, with the living-target set re-derived per hit on both sides (AttackCommand.cs:544-546). WRONG RNG STREAM (historical, since fixed): C# rolls `Rng.CombatTargets.NextItem(validTargets)` per hit (AttackCommand.cs:601-602); the sim USED TO call `ctx.combat._rng.choice(living)` on the unseeded shared `random.Random`, even though `ctx.combat.combat_rng.targets` maps to `combat_targets` (combat_rng.py:22,54). Same mechanism and same verdict as card/rip_and_tear's OnPlay entry (rule 3); LIVE, and this is the 12th of the 21 cards the `shared-rng` probe lists. card/sword_boomerang -- the same multi-hit random-target shape -- shows the correct fix, branching on `crng.is_parity` and using `crng.targets`. REGRESSION TEST: `test/test_rng_tripwire.py` (`test_no_wrong_stream_draws_in_random_run`, 20 seeded full runs) is the standing gate for this whole family. It wraps `RunState.rng` (run.py:174, moved from :1146-1148) and asserts ZERO in-combat draws on it; `CombatState` receives that same object as `self._rng` (combat.py:153, moved from :88), so a `ctx.combat._rng` draw taken from inside a card's `on_play` is recorded and fails the gate. The gate is green today, and this card's own site no longer even touches `ctx.combat._rng`, so the tripwire finding is moot for card/volley specifically; the test remains the standing gate for any future regression in the family.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.Damage.UpgradeValueBy(4m)` (Volley.cs:32) == `self._damage += 4` (10 -> 14 per hit). The hit count stays X on both sides.
